body:
## Escalation: this is now **evicting PRs from the merge queue**, not just reddening PR checks

Measured since filing.

**Two PRs were dequeued with `CI_FAILURE`** by `github-merge-queue[bot]`:

| PR | dequeued |
|---|---|
| #10796 | 12:03:15Z |
| #10795 | 12:08:05Z |

I pulled the queue run for #10796 (`gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-10796-f4e5d916d6…`, run `32479614166`, job `96762967184` — `Lint & Repo Gates`) and the failing line is this defect, verbatim:

```
2026-08-21T12:02:47Z  git-history --self-test: 3 FAILED.
2026-08-21T12:02:47Z  ##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
```

So the full sequence is: a PR goes green on its own checks before 12:00Z → enters the queue → the queue rebuilds against a base that runs the same self-test after 12:00Z → fails → PR is evicted. Both of those PRs were reviewed, green, and queued before the boundary.

**Two others merged just before it bit** — #10787 at 12:01:58Z and #10786 at 12:02:25Z — which brackets the onset precisely and is further confirmation the code did not change.

## ⛔ Do not re-queue anything until this lands

Re-queuing now fails identically and burns a full rebuild for every PR behind it in the batch — the exact cost the merge-queue triage workflow warns about. #10795 and #10796 stay dequeued deliberately; I will re-arm them once this is fixed, and I have said so on both.

## What this changes about the fix

Nothing about the diagnosis — the root cause and the reproduction in the body still stand unchanged. What it changes is the **cost of getting it wrong**: a fix that is merely green when run now would be indistinguishable from the bug's own daily green window, and shipping that would leave the queue evicting PRs again tomorrow afternoon with everyone believing it was already fixed.

That is why the dispatch requires proof on **both sides of 12:00 UTC** — by faking the clock, or by a structural argument that no boundary can land within a day of a fixture stamp. ⛔ A single green run at any one time of day is not evidence here, and after today it is specifically the evidence the bug itself produces.
